result:
✅ **Roster screen complete and building successfully!**

I've implemented the roster screen per the build spec with:

**Core Components:**
- **RosterViewModel**: Handles all filtering, searching, and sorting logic with signals
- **Roster Component**: MVVM pattern with thin template binding to `vm` signals

**UI Features:**
- **Filter bar**: Search input (by name/alias/ID) + class dropdown filter + Recruit button
- **Desktop table** (768px+): 6 columns (Hero, Class, Power, Status, Clearance, Actions) with edit/delete buttons
- **Mobile cards** (375px): Stacked card layout showing hero info, class/status/clearance badges, mission count, and actions
- **Summary footer**: Hero counts and sort indicator
- **Empty state**: When filters match no heroes

**Technical Details:**
- Uses spartan primitives: `hlm-table`, `hlm-badge`, `hlmInput`, `hlmBtn`, `hlm-select`
- Icons from lucide via `@ng-icons/core`
- Responsive at 375px (card layout), 768px, 1280px—no horizontal page scroll
- Example data: 12 heroes with status (Active/Injured/Reserve/MIA), power classes, clearance tiers
- Theme tokens from `:root` CSS variables (cool indigo palette with amber action color)
- Builds clean with no errors (warning: bundle 66kB over budget, not blocking)

The responsive solution uses **option (b)** from the spec: card-based layout on mobile, table on tablet/desktop—both pass the Part 5 responsive gate requirements.
